mapper.select: SELECT policy_id::TEXT AS db_key, title, content, type_cd, req_yn, ordr, use_yn FROM t_policy WHERE policy_id = #{dbKey}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_policy (title, content, type_cd, req_yn, ordr, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{typeCd}, COALESCE(#{reqYn}, 'Y'), -- 같은 약관유형(type_cd) 내 마지막 순서+1 자동 부여 COALESCE(NULLIF(#{ordr}, '')::integer, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ordr), 0) + 1 FROM t_policy WHERE type_cd = #{typeCd} AND use_yn = 'Y')), 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_policy SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, type_cd = #{typeCd}, req_yn = #{reqYn}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE policy_id = #{dbKey}::integer
mapper.select:
SELECT policy_id::TEXT AS db_key, ordr FROM t_policy WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND type_cd = #{typeCd}
AND ordr < #{ordr}::integer ORDER BY ordr DESC
AND ordr > #{ordr}::integer ORDER BY ordr ASC
LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_policy SET ordr = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{ordr}, '')::integer, 0), upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE policy_id = #{dbKey}::integer
UPDATE t_policy SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE policy_id = #{dbKey}::integer

UPDATE t_policy SET ordr = ordr - 1, upd_dt = NOW() WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND type_cd = (SELECT type_cd FROM t_policy WHERE policy_id = #{dbKey}::integer) AND ordr > (SELECT ordr FROM t_policy WHERE policy_id = #{dbKey}::integer)
